body:
Create Hebrew and English JLPTEI projects for the 1965 Heidenheim–Marmorstein first-day Rosh ha-Shanah maḥzor, and an expanded service assembled in recitation order through canonical URNs.

Accepted coverage is **276 of 355 scan pages**: PDF 1–275 plus the Hebrew-only appendix pilot on 351. All **766 literal witnesses and 145 canonical realization payloads** are accepted, with human questions through 414 settled. The 804 generated XML files pass RelaxNG and Schematron validation. Next is Zikhronot on PDF 276; 79 pages remain. This PR stays draft while the volume continues. The earlier 254-page count included two partial leaves; the corrected complete count before this installment was 252.

The importer separates edition contexts from reusable prayer words, reuses existing canonical identities, preserves missing English translations, and binds shared corrections to exact source attestations. Documentary and expanded sequences retain the edition’s rite conditions and actor cues. The cantor’s Aleinu repeat extends through וידעת היום. Weekday and Shabbat Malkhuyot poems remain continuous complete alternatives. Chapter/verse scopes, unique Archive leaf links, citations and bilingual alignment are independently reviewed. The earlier 720 literal witnesses remain unchanged; the frozen baseline now covers all 766.

Validation: 194 targeted tests/260 subtests; 804 full schema checks; naming, feature, registry and reference checks; 52 print/electronic compilation cases, 19 canonical source projections, 79 quotation extents and four full morning selections. Independent Claude Opus 5.5 review approves source, encoding guidelines, alignment, order, identity and final export QA. Full Hebrew, parallel and expanded previews contain 77/210/236 pages; all six desktop/mobile HTML states pass. Exact review payloads, findings and closure evidence are committed with the sources.

Paired sources: opensiddur/sourcetexts#54. Paired projects: opensiddur/opensiddur-projects#102. Merge this processor dependency before the projects. Exporter corrections remain separate in #310, #312 and #313; previews use their combined QA runtime. #311 is merged. Contributes to #214.
